intent.who: Risk analysts who already know the portfolio names
intent.cadence: Several times an hour during the morning close
intent.primaryAction: Run a fresh report against the selected portfolio
intent.failure: The run times out and the analyst has to explain the gap
intent.scale: Four hundred rows on a bad day, twelve on a normal one

layout.region: footer with the last run time

states.empty: No reports yet for this portfolio, with the run button repeated inline as the way out
states.loading: Skeleton rows at the last known row count so the table does not collapse and jump
states.error: The run failed, the reason the service gave, and a retry that keeps the selected portfolio
states.populated: Four hundred rows paginated at fifty, newest first, with the count stated above the table

revisions.note: First draft ranked the portfolio selector first. Running a report is the primary action; selecting is setup for it.
